entities.name: Adaptive Retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval strategy where models autonomously determine the optimal moments to finish retrieval activities.

entities.name: ToG
entities.description: A method that prompts an LLM agent to explore multiple possible reasoning paths until the LLM determines the question can be answered.

entities.name: RoBERTa
entities.description: A model trained to expand a path from each topic entity, using a virtual relation '[END]' to terminate retrieval.

entities.name: Multi-Stage Retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval approach that divides the process linearly into multiple stages, potentially employing different retrievers for each stage.

relationships.description: ToG is an example of a method that utilizes adaptive retrieval by letting the LLM determine when to stop exploring reasoning paths.
The RoBERTa-based approach uses a termination signal ('[END]') to stop retrieval, fitting the definition of adaptive retrieval.
